sloka: ्वं हि कस्यचित्प्राणिनो भुवि ।अथाब्रवीत्स तत्रस्थं मेघनादो महाबलः ।श्रूयतां वा भवेत्सिद्धिः शतक्रतुविमोक्षणे ।। ७.३०.१३ ॥
transliteration: ्vaṁ hi kasyacitprāṇino bhuvi ।athābravītsa tatrasthaṁ meghanādo mahābalaḥ ।śrūyatāṁ vā bhavetsiddhiḥ śatakratuvimokṣaṇe ।। 7.30.13 ॥

translations.english: Then the mighty Meghanada spoke to Brahma, who was present there, saying, "Let it be heard, or may there be success in releasing Indra."
